templates.title: Price list
How to order
templates.body:
You can design your sign on your phone here: {design_link}
Pick your text, font, size and colour, check the proof, and place the order. You'll get an order number and payment instructions right away.

templates.title: Payment instructions
templates.body: Thanks for your order! Please send an Interac e-Transfer to {payment_email} and put your order number in the message. We start on your sign as soon as payment arrives.

templates.title: Arranging pickup
templates.body: {pickup_note} What days and times work best for you?

templates.title: Order ready
templates.body: Good news, your sign is ready! When would you like to pick it up?
